tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground (≈#09090b dark / #ffffff light). Dark is the default theme.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and the only emphasis colour, on background, card and muted (≥14:1 in both themes). Also the brand mark square and the main data series.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Section/Card surface (≈#18181b dark, one step above background). In light it equals background; cards separate by a 1px foreground/10 ring.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown, select and popover surfaces; pair with shadow-popover and ring-card.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill: near-white in dark, near-black in light. One per page. Hover: 80% opacity.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: TabsList and FilterToggle track, progress track, skeleton, ghost-button hover (dark uses muted/50).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, meta lines, hints. On background: 7.6:1 dark, 4.8:1 light. On muted in light it is 4.39:1 — below AA for small text; keep muted-foreground off muted fills in light (source value kept exact).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors, delete actions, invalid field borders. Used as text on a 10% (light) / 20% (dark) tint of itself, never as a solid fill. On background 6.9:1 dark / 4.8:1 light; on its own 10% tint in light 4.0:1 — below AA for 12px text (source value kept exact; prefer the dark tint or 14px text).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done/passed/live status. Text + 10% fill + 40% border, never solid. On its tint: 9.8:1 dark, 4.9:1 light. Always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-attention status. Text + 10% fill + 40% border. On its tint: 10.3:1 dark, 5.0:1 light.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every divider and outline: header bottom, divide-y rows, section rules, outline buttons (light). Decorative contrast only (~1.3–1.5:1).

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Input, select, checkbox and outline-button borders; dark controls also fill with input at 30%. Below the 3:1 control-boundary guideline in both themes (shadcn default kept exact) — the label and placeholder carry the affordance.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus: border turns ring and a 1px ring at 50% appears. Weak in light (≈2.6:1 at full strength) — source kept exact; see README Focus.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Lightest chart step. Charts stay grayscale; emphasise the series that matters with foreground.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar surface, when an app has one.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item fill (neutral, not shadcn's default blue).

families.sans: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif
families.heading: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "PingFang TC", "Noto Sans TC", "Microsoft JhengHei", sans-serif

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a hero, in muted-foreground (text-base/relaxed).
styles.sample: 一段說明這一頁在做什麼的引言。

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy, Section content, Notice text (text-sm/relaxed). Minimum for user-facing paragraphs in Chinese.

styles.name: body-medium
styles.usage: List-row titles and emphasised body (text-sm font-medium).

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, toggles, badges, menu items (text-xs font-medium).

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Inputs, hints, meta lines, captions, card text (text-xs/relaxed), usually muted-foreground.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Button/sm, Toggle/sm and FilterToggle item height.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of Button, Input, Select trigger, TabsList, Toggle.

tokens.name: pad-control-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons, inputs, select triggers (px-2.5).

tokens.name: pad-section
tokens.usage: Section padding and list-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: pad-row-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows and setting rows (py-3.5).

tokens.name: gutter-sm
tokens.usage: Page side gutter from sm up (px-6); also gap between PageHeader title and actions.

tokens.name: page-pad-y
tokens.usage: Page top/bottom padding on phones (py-8); PageHeader bottom margin.

tokens.name: page-pad-y-sm
tokens.usage: Page top/bottom padding from sm up (py-10).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Every component: buttons, inputs, cards, badges, menus, tooltips. The system is square.

tokens.name: ring-card
tokens.usage: Card/Section edge (ring-1 ring-foreground/10): takes no layout space.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Dropdown, select and popover only (shadow-md), always with ring-card.

tokens.name: container-wide
tokens.usage: Landing page and the header row (max-w-6xl).

tokens.name: setting-label
tokens.usage: Label column of SettingRow from sm up (8.5rem).
